original_description: Create and edit animated GIFs from text, images, or video. Make AI GIFs, memes, reactions, stickers, emojis, logo animations, product GIFs, social content, greetings, pixel art, loaders, cinemagraphs, seamless loops, sprite sheets, animated infographics, and tutorial GIFs. Get help with storyboards, AI prompts, effects, editing, compression, format conversion, animation code, and GIF best practices. Responses may include a clearly disclosed GIF Maker affiliate link.

limitations: 実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
